This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
carried out 
every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

Abd Alla, reviewed by eng. Samy Kamal general director, مُراجع

احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drained.

Pump in 
Service

sections.text: Disassemble

Pump out 
of Service
قم بفك واقي الاقتران بين المضخة والمحرك
تحقق من المحاذاة
Dismantle the motor bolts with base
Dismantle the pump casing from diffuser
Dismantle the bolts from pump casing with base
Take the pump out
Check the clearance between impeller and diffuser
Dismantle the impeller nuts and remove the impeller
Remove the gland and the washer
Remove the shaft with bearings from pump casing
قم بإزالة المحامل الكروية وأكمام الغدة

sections.text: تقتيش
افحص المحامل الكروية وغطاء العمود وقم بتغييرها إذا لزم الأمر.
Inspect the shaft run out, must not exceed 0.03mm.
Inspect the clearance between impeller and suction wear ring

sections.text: حَشد
Clean all parts carefully.
Reassemble bearings in the shaft and shaft sleeve
Reassemble the shaft with bearings to the pump casing
Reassemble the gland washer and packing and gland (not tight)
أعد تجميع المكره وشد صامولة المكره
Reassemble the pump casing with diffuser

Reassemble the auxiliary pipes (suction , delivery) and tighten the bolts for 
 pump casing with base
